overview_description.description:
Chaos Genius is a provider of a DataOps observability platform for improving data infrastructure efficiency. It has developed a unique data infrastructure observability and optimization product that’s initially aimed at Snowflake Inc.’s cloud data warehouse platform. Organizations can save money on Snowflake by receiving automated recommendations to optimize their workloads, identify inefficient queries, and improve query performance. The platform analyzes Snowflake workloads with millions of queries using query patterns to identify inefficient queries and provides intelligent recommendations that significantly improve performance.

The company was founded in 2021 by Preeti Shrimal and Harshit Surana. The company is based in Palo Alto, California.

product.name: Autonomous Agents for Data & AI Cost Optimization
product.description: A platform that automates tuning and optimization of data warehouses and clusters to reduce compute and storage costs on platforms like Snowflake and Databricks.

product.name: Instance Rightsizing for Snowflake
product.description: Automated recommendations and tuning for optimal sizing and configuration of Snowflake warehouses to reduce compute costs.

identifier.value: Query Tuning for Snowflake and Databricks

product.name: Query Tuning for Snowflake and Databricks
product.description: A tool that identifies expensive queries and workloads and provides automated tuning recommendations to improve performance and reduce compute costs.

product.name: Database Optimization
product.description: A service that identifies unused tables and optimizes storage costs by cleaning up unused data in databases on platforms like Snowflake and Databricks.

product.name: Alerts & Reporting
product.description: A feature that provides alerts and reports on cost spikes, inefficiencies, and anomalies in data infrastructure usage.
